{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Bakken East Pipeline''' is a natural gas pipeline in the United States, with 2 segments.

==Location==
Main Line: The pipeline is proposed to run from Watford City, North Dakota to Mapleton, North Dakota.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wbienergy.com/bakken-east|title=wbienergy.com|website=wbienergy.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
Jamestown to Ellendale Lateral: The pipeline was proposed to run from Jamestown, North Dakota to Ellendale, North Dakota.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://industrialinfo.com/news/article/north-dakotas-500-million-pipeline-funding-paves-way-for-industrial-development--357127|title=industrialinfo.com|website=industrialinfo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2025/november/wbi-energy-advances-plans-for-bakken-east-gas-pipeline-to-serve-power-data-center-growth|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
